offers.sn: B2B - COMMERCIEEL VASTGOED - Voor een toonaangevende speler in vastgoedbeheer zijn we op zoek naar een Building & Facility Manager.
In the Hardware R&D team Defense & Security you will contribute to the development of defense and air traffic control displays, video network encoder/decoders and full console systems.
offers.rq: You have a Master’s degree in Electronics or equivalent by experience. You are fluent in Dutch and English.

offers.sn: As a member of the Avionics Hardware R&D team, you will contribute to the development of display and computer systems, which are integrated in the cockpit of aircraft and helicopters.
offers.rq: You hold a Master’s degree in electronics or engineering. You are fluent in English.
